title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior emerges and spreads in a population through social influence, policy interventions, risk perception, and supply constraints, and assess downstream effects on contacts and disease transmission.

interactions.name: social_observation_and_influence
interactions.description: People observe mask use among their social contacts and adjust their adoption probability based on conformity and perceived norms.

interactions.name: policy_announcement_and_compliance
interactions.description: Authority announces mask mandates or recommendations; people update compliance decisions based on trust and enforcement intensity.

interactions.name: enforcement_event
interactions.description: Locations and/or Authority enforce mask policies during visits, leading to compliance, warnings, or fines.

interactions.name: purchase_mask
interactions.description: People acquire masks from suppliers subject to inventory, price, and quality availability.

interactions.name: visit_location_and_contacts
interactions.description: People move through locations (home, work, school, community) and form contacts that may influence adoption and disease spread.

interactions.name: disease_transmission_contact
interactions.description: During contacts, infection may occur with probability reduced by mask wearing and quality, and increased by location risk.

interactions.name: media_message_broadcast
interactions.description: Authority and media channels broadcast messages that affect risk perception and trust, countered by misinformation exposure.

interactions.name: inventory_supply_chain_update
interactions.description: Suppliers restock and adjust prices based on demand and stock, influencing future adoption feasibility.

metrics.name: adoption_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of the population correctly wearing masks over time.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until the population reaches at least 50% correct mask use.

metrics.name: peak_adoption
metrics.description: Maximum observed adoption rate during the simulation and the day it occurs.

metrics.name: average_compliance_under_mandate
metrics.description: Mean mask-wearing rate during periods when a mandate is active.

metrics.name: infections_averted
metrics.description: Estimated reduction in infections compared to a counterfactual scenario with no mask adoption.

metrics.name: effective_reproduction_number_Rt
metrics.description: Estimated effective reproduction number over time under observed mask use.

metrics.name: equity_gap_in_adoption
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rates between defined subgroups (e.g., low vs high income).

metrics.name: stockout_days
metrics.description: Number of days suppliers have zero mask inventory.

metrics.name: mask_quality_distribution
metrics.description: Distribution of mask quality among mask users over time.
